feel: What I like: semantic tags kept (header, nav, section, article, h1-h3, img with alt), no inline style, no div soup, one stylesheet, images and fonts at their paths.

What I would reject in review: class names are Portuguese and numbered (secao__titulo-3, secao-3__botao-4, barra-de-navegacao__link-2); identical rules repeated under different names (39 of 109); padding written as four longhands everywhere; no shorthand.
The 6 testimonials share one class (good: the component works in the code too); the price cards share .card.
Nav links have no href, buttons no type, <html> no lang: Checks flags some of it, not all.
wish: Readable names: from the role and the project language, and merge identical rules into one class.

issues.what: Exported CSS is ~5x the hand-written equivalent: 39 of 109 rules duplicate another's body; 310 longhand declarations; numbered generated names
Class names come from layer names in the author's language and numbering (secao__titulo-3)
No lang, no button type and links without href reach the export; Checks covers href but not lang or type

notes: Export of Home + Wholesale. CSS 16,985 bytes / 109 rules (39 redundant: identical bodies under other names), 310 longhand declarations; the hand-written target is 3,445 bytes / 48 rules. html-validate: 8 errors (lang x2, button type x6), 0 inline styles.
